brief_item.title: LMCache rc2提供CUDA 12.9兼容轮子
brief_item.core_conclusion: LMCache v0.5.3rc2发布CUDA 12.9轮子，并给出使用PyTorch cu129索引和expanded-assets链接的安装方式。它解决匹配CUDA环境的安装前置，不提供KVCache传输或Serving性能证据。
brief_item.mechanism: 文档使用uv pip安装，额外指定PyTorch CUDA 12.9索引，并采用unsafe-best-match策略解析依赖。轮子对应LMCache v0.5.3rc2和CUDA 12.9目标环境。
brief_item.result: 发布页明确记录CUDA 12.9构建和cu129安装命令，未提供吞吐、传输延迟、网络利用率或模型Serving测量。
brief_item.boundary: release candidate不保证所有CUDA驱动、PyTorch、vLLM或GPU组合可用。unsafe-best-match可能混用多个包索引，需在锁定环境中验证。
brief_item.project_relevance: 该轮子可作为CUDA 12.9上复现LMCache实验的环境前置条件。比较网络结果时应固定CUDA、PyTorch和vLLM版本，不能将安装成功当作调度收益。

facts.title: LMCache/LMCache Release v0.5.3rc3 · CUDA 12.9

facts.mechanism: The GitHub release provides a CUDA 12.9 build for LMCache v0.5.3rc3 and directs users to install it with uv pip, the PyTorch CUDA 12.9 extra index, the release's expanded-assets link, and unsafe-best-match index strategy.

evidence.claim: The release is titled v0.5.3rc3 and targets CUDA 12.9.
The release instructs users to install lmcache with uv pip using the PyTorch cu129 extra index and the release's expanded assets link.

facts.project_relevance: A CUDA 12.9 wheel may unblock reproducing LMCache experiments on matching infrastructure, but this release alone provides no evidence of changes to KV-cache transfer performance or network scheduling.
